name: A Teacher
description: Claire Wilson, a young teacher at a suburban Texas high school, begins an affair with her student, Eric Walker. But their relationship accelerates faster than anticipated and the permanent damage becomes impossible to ignore.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Claire starts her first day teaching at a new school and meets her students, including Eric, a senior in her AP English class.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Eric gets caught for underage drinking and a new friend helps bail him out. Claire takes Eric on a field trip to a nearby college.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Tensions arise as Claire and Matt explore pregnancy options. Claire chaperones the homecoming dance and Eric comes clean about his true feelings.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Claire outlines the rules Eric must follow as their relationship takes a dramatic turn.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Claire and Eric go away on a secret trip to celebrate his 18th birthday.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: As Claire's world begins to crumble, an uncertain Eric is pressed to reveal intimate details of his relationship.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Eric tries to move on, but fallout from the affair continues to resurface in unexpected ways.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Claire attempts to restart her life. However, not everyone is ready for her to turn the page.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Claire and Eric separately hit their breaking points.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Claire and Eric have seemingly moved on with their lives, but a chance encounter brings new truths to light.
